RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the August 7, 2006/Sravana 16, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Development of North-Eastern Region; Earth Sciences; Food
Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Law and Justice; Mines;
Minority Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power;
Science and Technology; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions —20
India as sixth most dangerous country
for children
*201. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have taken note
of the Poll Survey conducted by the Reuters
Alternet news portal under the Reuters
Foundation ranking India as the sixth most
dangerous country for children in the world;
(b) whether countries like Afghanistan,
Palestine, Myanmar and Chechenya have been
ranked better than India in this survey; and
(c) whether high rate of infant mortality,
malnutrition and prevalence of child labour
are the factors attributed to the low ranking
of India in this survey?
Objectionable facts in textbooks
†*202.SHRI PYARELAL KHAN-
DELWAL: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that highly
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
objectionable facts are being taught regarding
gods and goddesses of  Hindus, particularly
god Shiva and goddess Durga in the syllabus
of M.A. (History) conducted by "IGNOU";
(b) whether it is also a fact that a
conspiracy of showing disrespect has been
hatched in a well-planned manner to Hindu
gods and goddesses in the book titled
"Dharmik Paramparyen Aur Bhakti
Darshan";
(c) if so, the action Government are
going to take against the writers who have
prepared the said syllabus; and
(d) if not, the thinking behind inclusion of
the facts in syllabus through various
Government channels which amount only to
hurt the feelings of Hindus?
Projects with the Ministry
*203. SHRI PRAVEEN RASHTRA-
PAL: Will the Minister of  NON-
CONVENTIONAL ENERGY SOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the projects on hand with Ministry
as on the 28th February, 2006;

63
(b) the details of various projects in the
State of Gujarat; and
(c) whether Government agree that there
is great scope in Gujarat due to availability
of desert, arid zone and longest coastline?
Sub-categorisation of Dalits
*204. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry of Law and
Justice has opined that sub-categorisation
of Dalits would run foul of the Supreme
Court order in view of the proposal being
made for quota-regime within the Dalits;
(b) if so, whether the wide spectrum of
divergent opinion from different quarters
has been taken into consideration; and
(c) whether there will be a uniform
quota-regime system throughout the
country or will it differ from State-to-State?
Seats in professional, medical and
engineering courses
@*205. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
 SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of students passing out
Class 12 in Science streams from CBSE
Board during the last three years, year-wise:
(b) the annual increase in seats in
professional, medical and engineering
courses during the corresponding period;
(c) whether the gap between number of
Science students passing out of schools and
seats available for medical and engineering
courses has increased over the years;
(d) if so, the steps being taken to
drastically remove the shortage of seats vis-
a-vis increasing demand for such courses; and
(e) whether Government have looked
into these issues, and if so, the findings
thereof?
Pilot power project in Dhangaon
*206. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the pilot project of micro energy
in Dhangaon, District Nandurbar, which has
set an excellent example of starting power
project with active public participation;
(b) if so, the salient features thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that the cost and
production ratio of this said power project
is also very good as compared to the other
Government power projects;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) whether Government will come out
with a good package to promote such low
budget experiment in various parts of the
country?
Import of processed food items
*207. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
import of processed food items is adversely
affecting the indigenous food processing
industries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the names of those Indian companies
which are using brand name of foreign
companies for their processed food items; and
(d) the action taken against such
companies?

Air services as joint venture
1329. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the DoNER
has started looking for joint venture to
operate the regional air service;
(b) whether his Ministry had
discussions with the Air Deccan and the
Kingfisher Airlines to operate air services
as joint venture; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
percentage of capital to be invested in the
proposed joint venture?
Inclusion of roads through NEC
1330. SHRI SILVIUS CONDPAN: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state whether Government would
consider the inclusion of Orang-Kopati-
Dolgaon Road through NEC under Eleventh
Five Year Plan considering its importance
to connect the Orang Wildlife Sanctuary
for the interest of tourists and cover the
missing link between NH-52 and Orang-
Mazbad Rupa Road?
Projects for NER
1331. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the names of the projects received
from different State Governments of NER
during 2005-06 and 2006-07 for
consideration of the NEC;
(b) the projects which have been
accepted by the NEC for consideration
alongwith the amount sanctioned and the
projects which have not been accepted by
NEC alongwith reasons therefor;
(c) the projects which have been running
in Tripura prior to 2005-06; and
(d) the reasons for unusual delay?

308
Daily wastage of vegetables
and fruits
1332. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large
quantity of vegetables and fruits perishes
daily in the country due to lack of proper
processing facilities;
(b) if so, the quantity of vegetables and
fruits wasted daily in the country and the
steps being taken/proposed to be taken to
process the vegetables/fruits;
(c) whether Government propose to
follow developed countries like the USA in
developing processing industry in the
country; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Development of FPIs in Assam
1333. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether, in view of the high
potential for food processing industries
development in Assam and other North
Eastern States, any plan has been drawn
out for development of such industries in
different States and parts of North East,
particularly in Barak Valley in Assam;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the cost and Government's
participation contemplated thereunder;
and
(d) the steps taken and being taken to
implement the same?
Projects for food processing units in
Gujarat
1334. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) the projects and other resources
provided to the State of Gujarat in the
matter concerning food processing during
the last five years;
(b) whether Government are aware of
great scope for establishing processing units
in North Gujarat for the products of isabgul
and carrot; and
(c) the facilities to be provided by
Government if local industrialists come
forward for establishing such units in North
Gujarat?
Projects for NER
1335. SHRI NABAM REBIA: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of projects sanctioned
by Government in North-Eastern Region
during 2002-03, 2003-04, 2004-05 and
2005-06 indicating the fund allotted,
project-wise and State-wise;
(b) the number of new projects
proposed to be taken up in the current
financial year and funds earmarked therefor,
State-wise; and
(c) the new incentives/initiatives to
promote such industries in the region?
Fillip to global agri-products trade
1336. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to

309
FICCI, our food processing industry needs
a fillip in the form of fiscal support in order
to enhance country's share in the global
agri-products trade;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
during the last two years in this regard;
(c) whether FICCI has also submitted
any proposals to Government during the
last one year;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken thereon?
Investment in food processing
industry
